title: Helmet use among riders 18 and under with e-scooter head injuries

source.name: Pediatric e-scooter injury study using CPSC NEISS data
source.publisher: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) / American Academy of Pediatrics

notes: Among e-scooter riders 18 and under who were treated for head injuries, nearly 67% were not wearing a helmet at the time.
